body:
Tested on a Pixel 5 (Adreno 620, Android 15) with your `ShaderCompilationIssue` 3D scene (100 unique scene-shader materials), GL Compatibility. Built `master` base (`81ab961f`) vs this PR (`96d9d4e`), arm64 `template_debug`, `swappy=no`, identical flags. Metric: the synchronous compile stall (largest frame gap after the meshes are added), median of n=3.

| | no cache (cold) | cache (warm) |
|---|---|---|
| master | 3118 ms | 2217 ms |
| this PR | 1612 ms | 1531 ms |
| speedup | 1.93× | 1.45× |

So on Adreno the win is smaller than your desktop numbers (as expected — driver-side compile/link dominates on mobile), but it's a solid, reproducible ~1.9× cold / ~1.45× warm with pixel-identical output (screenshots byte-identical). No regressions seen. Happy to test other scenes if useful.
